title: Bijectivity of scalar extension of twisted Galois matrix invariants
statement: Let K be a field, S its separable closure, n any natural number and b:Gal(S/K) → GL_n(S) locally constant for the Krull topology. Put T_g(M)=b(g) g(M) b(g) inverse. Assume T_1(M)=M and T_g(T_h(M))=T_(gh)(M) for all g,h,M. Then the explicit multiplication map S tensor_K A_b → Mat_n(S) of [def-sc-matrix-descent-invariants] is bijective. There is no positivity assumption on n and no central simplicity assertion.

source.place: Tag 03R6, Galois forms of matrix algebras; finite Galois descent expanded from parent steps 1 and 2

proof.text: Choose a K-basis c of the explicitly constructed invariant algebra A_b. The base-change basis of S tensor_K A_b has elements 1 tensor c_i. The explicit scalar map sends these elements to the underlying invariant matrices c_i.

The underlying matrices c_i are S-linearly independent by the invariant independence theorem; the original c_i are K-linearly independent because they form a basis. This proves injectivity by LinearMap.injective_of_linearIndependent.

The S-span of the underlying c_i equals the S-span of A_b: the K-basis spans A_b, and a K-linear combination is also an S-linear combination. The invariant spanning theorem makes this span top. LinearMap.bijective_of_linearIndependent_of_span_eq_top applied to the base-change basis and these two facts proves bijectivity of the exact scalar map.

proof_origin.place: K-basis coefficient uniqueness proved over the separable closure; invariant spanning reduced to finite Galois descent; Module.Basis.baseChange and LinearMap.bijective_of_linearIndependent_of_span_eq_top

lean.statement:
theorem matrixDescentScalarMap_bijective (K : Type u) [Field K]
    (n : ℕ)
    (b : (SeparableClosure K ≃ₐ[K] SeparableClosure K) →
      Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup (Fin n) (SeparableClosure K))
    (hb : IsLocallyConstant b)
    (h1 : ∀ M : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) (SeparableClosure K),
      (b 1).val * M * ((b 1)⁻¹).val = M)
    (hm : ∀ g h (M : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) (SeparableClosure K)),
      (b g).val * ((b h).val * M.map h * ((b h)⁻¹).val).map g * ((b g)⁻¹).val =
        (b (g * h)).val * M.map (g * h) * ((b (g * h))⁻¹).val) :
    Function.Bijective (matrixDescentScalarMap K n b)
